DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Wat?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Komm schon!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Is' nicht
schlimm, wenn's bei dir unordentlich
ist!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich räum für dich auf!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}It's been a while since I went to a 
friend's place for a visit.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I should
maybe get out more. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Buf, ni recuerdo la última vez que
fui de visita a casa de un colega...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Es que tanto ir de fiesta
no me deja tiempo para nada!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Chuis toujours ravie d'aller traîner
chez les potes,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}È da un sacco di tempo che
non vado a casa di amici.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dovrei
uscire più spesso, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bir arkadaşın evine misafirliğe
gitmeyeli bayağı olmuş.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Galiba biraz
daha dışarı çıkmam lazım. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}This might surprise you, but people
say I'm a good guest.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I think it's just 'cause that's the
way I was raised! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
No te lo creerás, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}pero todo
el mundo dice que soy una
invitada alucinante.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Eso es porque siempre estoy
tan cansada que apenas abro
la boca. ¡Ji, ji, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ça va t'surprendre, mais les gens
qui m'invitent me félicitent toujours
pour mes bonnes manières !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Faut dire qu'j'ai été élevée à la
dure, hi hi !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Lo so che non ci credi, ma la gente
dice che sono un'ospite modello.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}In fondo, quando arriva il momento,
so fare la persona educata anche io,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Şaşırabilirsin ama iyi misafirimdir
derler.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Herhâlde beni böyle
yetiştirdikleri içindir! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I'm finally gonna get to see the
inside of your place! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}No me puedo creer que por fin vaya
a ver cómo es tu casa. ¡Se acabó
el misterio, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Finalmente vengo a casa tua! Sono
curiosa di sapere come l'hai
arredata, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}You can learn a lot about someone
by seeing the inside of their house.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}So I wonder what I'm gonna learn
about you, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Dicen que las casas reflejan la
personalidad de su dueño. {{TAG:0003:002B:}}Entonces,
¿para qué son los espejos?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}L'intérieur d'une baraque en dit long
sur qui y vit.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Je m'demande c'que j'vais bien
pouvoir apprendre sur toi,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Si riescono a capire un sacco
di cose su una persona, quando
si va a casa sua.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Magari scoprirò qualcosa di nuovo
su di te, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Du wärst überrascht, was man alles
über 'ne Person lernt, wenn man
ihre Hütte besucht.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Ich frag mich, was ich gleich alles
über dich rausfinde, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}İnsanın evini görünce onun hakkında
çok şey öğrenirsin.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Bakalım senin hakkında
neler öğreneceğim, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}C'était quand la dernière fois que
chuis venue chez toi, déjà ?!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ça m'a
presque manqué !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Evvai!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Non mi dispiace per niente
venire di nuovo a casa tua, anzi...
sono felice, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Has anything changed since last
time I was at your place?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I can't wait! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bueno, ¿habrá cambiado algo
desde la última vez que vine?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Nervios, intriga... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hai fatto qualche cambiamento
a casa tua dall'ultima volta che
sono venuta?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Beh, lo scoprirò, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Haste umdekoriert, seitdem ich das
letzte Mal bei dir war?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Wie aufregend! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Geçen gelişimden beri evinde bir şeyler
değişti mi?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Görmek
için sabırsızlanıyorum! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ma che fai?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Smettila di perdere
tempo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Non mi pare che casa tua
sia sulla spiaggia!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Non ho bisogno di fare un giro
turistico.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Forza, andiamo!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Was?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Genug rumgehampelt!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich
weiß ganz genau, dass du nicht am
Strand wohnst!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wir haben genug Zeit verplempert.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Mach hin! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Bon sang, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} On va quand
même pas prendre le train pour aller
chez toi, nan ?!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mais bon, si t'as autre chose de
prévu, on peut très bien remettre ça
à plus tard{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Alors, on fait quoi ?{{TAG:000F:0000:15002800}}
Oups ! Allons-y !
Plus tard, ouais...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Mach mal hin!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wir wollten doch zu
dir nach Hause, oder verraff ich's
grade total?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Wenn du was anderes vorhast, dann
lass uns einfach ein andermal ge-
meinsam abhängen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Was soll's sein?{{TAG:000F:0000:00000000}}
Hab nichts anderes vor!
Hups, erwischt.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Huh?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Are we going on a trip first
or something?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}If you're gonna take a huge detour,
I'll just head home{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} So what's it
gonna be?{{TAG:000F:0000:15002800}}
Let's head to my place!
Let's do this later!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿Ein?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¿Qué pasa, me vas a llevar
de turisteo antes?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Mira, si vas a estar dando vueltas,
mejor me vuelvo a casa.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} A ver,
¿qué vas a hacer?{{TAG:000F:0000:15002800}}
Vamos a mi casa
¡Nos vemos luego!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Ci facciamo prima un giretto?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Se hai intenzione di continuare
a perdere tempo, me ne vado
a casa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Che facciamo?{{TAG:000F:0000:15002800}}
Andiamo da me!
Torna a casa.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ha?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Önce geziye falan mı çıkıyoruz?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Böyle
kocaman bir dolambaç yapacaksak ben eve
döneyim{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Karar ver bakalım.{{TAG:000F:0000:15002800}}
Benim eve gidelim!
Bunu sonra yapalım!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Se puede saber qué haces?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Venga,
déjate de tonterías y llévame a
tu casa, ¿sí, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Nan mais où tu vas, là ?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}On peut pas
tout simplement aller chez toi,
comme prévu ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Che stai facendo?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Che ne dici
di andare a casa tua una volta
per tutte, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
